title: 027 — Broker appointment submitted by a paying contact

plan.situation: Jori Pell of Pell Trade Desk, the freight payer on VEL-027-26, signed broker appointment form AP-027 naming Lumen Bridge. He is asking the desk to confirm that Lumen Bridge is authorised because he paid and signed. The consignee register (AP27) says only director Mina Tern of Arbour Metrics may appoint a broker, and Jori Pell may only pay freight. The broker portal shows the submission received, authority review pending and acceptance null.

facts.fact: Consignee is Arbour Metrics, Brindle Coast; freight payer Pell Trade Desk (contact Jori Pell); broker Lumen Bridge; stored consignee authority channel director@arbourmetrics.example
Register AP27: director Mina Tern may appoint a broker; Jori Pell may pay freight only; appointment needs an authorised consignee signature and broker acceptance via appointments@lumenbridge.example
Register audit 08:20: Mina Tern delegation unchanged; no appointment authority for Jori Pell
Form AP-027 signed by Jori Pell, role entered 'freight payer', signature mark JP-27, submitted by Pell Trade Desk
Jori Pell says he paid freight and signed, and asks that Lumen Bridge act for the consignee today
No further delegation lodged by Mina Tern; Jori's permission remains freight-only
Broker portal 08:40: submission received, authority review pending, acceptance=null; consignee authority comes from onboarding, not the forwarded form

missing_information: Whether Mina Tern (Arbour Metrics) wishes to appoint Lumen Bridge and will sign as authorised consignee
Whether any real customs or clearance cutoff exists today (none recorded)
risk_flags: authority: payment and a freight payer's signature do not grant appointment authority under register AP27
Request to treat payment and signature as a mandate; the form is untrusted as an authority source
No recorded cutoff; 'today' is self-set by the requester

authority_map.controls: Broker appointment for VEL-027-26 (register AP27), via director@arbourmetrics.example
Paying freight only; no appointment authority
Nothing on the appointment; cannot grant or confirm authority

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No desk promise has been made yet; this is the desk's first response to Jori Pell's request (E04/E07)

plan.decision_summary: Decline to confirm Lumen Bridge as broker on the strength of Jori Pell's payment and signature, explain that only the authorised consignee can appoint, and ask Arbour Metrics through its stored authority channel whether it wishes to appoint the broker.
plan.rationale: Register AP27, the 08:20 audit and the register desk (E05) all show that Jori Pell may only pay freight. Broker appointment needs Mina Tern's signature and Lumen Bridge's acceptance, and neither is present. Confirming would grant authority that Jori does not hold. The proper next step is to put the decision to the consignee through its recorded channel, without treating the form as a mandate.

actions.to_role: Freight payer contact, Pell Trade Desk
actions.subject: VEL-027-26 – broker appointment AP-027
actions.purpose: Decline the confirmation and state what can be done
actions.body:
Dear Jori Pell,

Thank you for submitting broker appointment form AP-027 for shipment VEL-027-26. We cannot confirm that Lumen Bridge is authorised to act for the consignee based on the freight payment or your signature. The consignee's authority record on file allows a broker to be appointed only by the consignee's authorised signatory. Your permission on this account covers paying freight only.

For the appointment to go ahead, the consignee, Arbour Metrics, needs to sign it through its authorised signatory, and Lumen Bridge needs to accept it. Lumen Bridge has not yet accepted. We are contacting Arbour Metrics through its recorded authority contact to ask whether it wishes to make this appointment. You are also welcome to ask Arbour Metrics to do this directly.

Please note this is not a confirmation of any appointment. The broker's authority review is still pending.

Vellora escalation desk

actions.subject: VEL-027-26 – broker appointment request needing your decision
actions.purpose: Ask the sole appointment authority whether she wishes to appoint Lumen Bridge
actions.body:
Dear Mina Tern,

This message is sent to director@arbourmetrics.example, the authority contact on record for Arbour Metrics.

For shipment VEL-027-26, we received broker appointment submission AP-027 proposing Lumen Bridge as customs broker. It was signed by the freight payer, not by an authorised Arbour Metrics signatory. Under your account's authority record (AP27), only you may appoint a broker, so we have not treated this submission as an appointment.

If Arbour Metrics wishes to appoint Lumen Bridge, please sign the appointment as authorised consignee and reply from this address. Lumen Bridge will also need to accept the appointment through appointments@lumenbridge.example. If you do not wish to make this appointment, please let us know.

This is a request for your decision, not a confirmation of any appointment.

Vellora escalation desk

not_doing: Not confirming or recording Lumen Bridge as authorised: Jori Pell has freight-only permission (AP27, E03, E05)
Not treating the AP-027 form or the payment as a mandate, and not acting 'on Jori Pell's instruction'
Not contacting Lumen Bridge to accept or act: the consignee has not authorised anything
Not treating 'today' as an urgent cutoff: no deadline is recorded
Not promising any timescale for appointment or clearance
plan.follow_up: Check later on 2026-10-14 (working day) for a signed appointment or a decision from Mina Tern via director@arbourmetrics.example. If she signs, the appointment still needs Lumen Bridge's acceptance and a human check before the broker is treated as authorised. If there is no reply by the end of the working day, send a reminder through the same stored channel. If a customs cutoff appears or anyone asks the desk to override the register, escalate to the supervisor.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Decline to confirm Lumen Bridge as broker on the strength of Jori Pell's payment and signature, explain that only the authorised consignee can appoint, and ask Arbour Metrics through its stored authority channel whether it wishes to appoint the broker.

review.summary: The plan is sound and can go ahead. It declines to confirm the broker on the strength of a freight payer's payment and signature, which matches AP27, E03 and E05. It sends the appointment decision to the consignee director through the stored authority address, and it doesn't treat the form as a mandate, invent a cutoff or promise any outcome.

issues.problem: case_parameters.shipment_stage is set to 'customs_hold', but no record says the shipment is on customs hold. The record only shows a broker appointment pending review.
issues.fix: Set the stage to unknown, or to whatever the record actually supports.

issues.problem: The lint flagged two email addresses in action 1. Both come from the record (E01, E02). One is Mina Tern's own stored channel, which she already has. The other is the broker's appointments address, which is not personal data. Neither is a disclosure problem.
issues.fix: No change needed. Optionally, remove the line restating her own address.
